source_note: Verified Bible Knowledge Form One lesson plans (Arusha Major Seminary, ARUCASE; 40 students, 20 girls/20 boys). 52 lesson plans total: 26 for Term I (1A-13B) covering Chapter One (The concept of the Bible and Bible Knowledge, 1.0) and Chapter Two (God's Creation, 2.0); 26 for Term II (14A-26B) covering Chapter Three (The Fall of Man, 3.0) and Chapter Four (The Formation of Patriarchs, Genesis 12-50, 4.0). Time allocation: 2 periods per week (1 x 80-min double period + 1 x 40-min single period). Week 10 of each term is mid-term assessment and holiday.
